Unresolved information

  • Record IDs and context counts do not count independent physical batches or replicates.
  • No atomic model, exact recipe–structure pair, universal cross-technique sample join or training admission is approved.
  • Pure process specifications and author refinement/model results are distinguished from experimental product observations.

Source distinctions and conflicts

  • C10: The short-range PDF discussion calls the 2.0 angstrom Zn reference octahedral in ZnAl2O4; the normal-spinel structural description places Zn tetrahedrally. Keep source context; no new coordination determination.
  • C5: Native legend says 1:0:0; caption/prose identify Al-only 0:2:0 (D4).
